findings.one_line: The standard one-regressor root-n reduction at degenerate X is not field-level as positioned: the note concedes gu2026optimally only displays nonmatching bounds, so it identifies no specific published product-converse, estimator, or workflow that this negative result refutes.
The clipped covariance estimator supplies the upper-rate deliverable but appears only in proof_tex; state it in the Stat target/theorem so the estimator and its rate are node-addressable.
